objective: Validate that machine no-yield authority sustains genuinely useful long-run work, then harden measurement and wake/recovery architecture without manufacturing utilization evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Hard continuation gate exists, is mandatory and CI-validated.
Healthy invocation crosses 840 seconds while continuing useful work.
Same-canonical overlap behavior is measured rather than assumed.
Wall-clock utilization audit excludes heartbeat-only evidence.
Independent wake candidates are tested honestly and negative results persisted.
checkpointable_substeps: Hard continuation gate and active-control registry.
Cross 840 seconds of live useful work.
Measure same-canonical overlap and recover scheduler forward.
Harden fixed-window substantive-evidence audit and independent wake architecture.
handoff_boundary: Current mode is LONG_RUN_WITH_SLIDING_COLD_RESCUE because same-canonical overlap was not observed. If a genuine independent successor appears, transfer at the smallest safe unit; otherwise continue until platform boundary while keeping a future rescue wake armed.
early_finish_fallback: Advance P0 measurement rigor, independent wake feasibility, recovery SLO, or another highest-value SaaS-competitiveness gap; never create filler merely to maintain evidence cadence.
progress_evidence: Hard continuation gate implemented and validated.
Epoch 18 crossed 840 seconds and remained productive beyond the 15-minute boundary.
01:15 same-canonical successor overlap was not observed; canonical was rolled forward to 01:30.
Actions rescue producer self-test passed under inactive guard.
Codex Cloud GitHub mention probe returned NOT_CONNECTED.
Fixed-window audit was hardened to exclude ACTIVITY-only heartbeats; this revoked a false PASS because the true max substantive evidence gap was 125 seconds versus 120 allowed.
Substantive evidence policy and separate abrupt-loss recovery SLO are now durable.
